name: Luma
label: Luma
description: Official Luma Dream Machine API at https://api.lumalabs.ai/dream-machine/v1. generate_video = POST /generations (returns generation id). Poll get_generation = GET /generations/{id} until state completed/failed. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth is StudioQuack secret api_key as Authorization Bearer. Image keyframes use HTTPS URLs (type file must be published to a URL Luma can fetch). Docs: https://docs.lumalabs.ai/docs/video-generation. Terms: https://lumalabs.ai/legal/tos. Never log api_key. Video URL is on assets.video when completed.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: generate_video requires prompt. Optional model, resolution, duration, aspect_ratio, loop, keyframes, concepts. Image-to-video: keyframes.frame0 = {type:"image", url:"https://..."}. get_generation requires id. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"prompt":"an old lady laughing underwater","model":"ray-2","resolution":"720p","duration":"5s"}.

schema.label: prompt
schema.description: Text prompt for generate_video. Official prompt. Required.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Create returns id + state (often dreaming). get_generation returns assets.video when completed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx (generation may still be dreaming).

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Upstream status code. Create is often 201.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: EXACT: generate_video | get_generation. Default generate_video = POST /generations. Poll get_generation; do not treat create as the finished video.

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Luma API key from https://platform.lumalabs.ai/. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: Default model id. Official docs list ray-2 and ray-flash-2. Put model on INPUT so it is sent in the JSON body.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-HTTP-call timeout. Default 60. Floor 1. Poll get_generation for completion.
